parser: page.extract_text(visitor_text=visitor), full pages joined by one newline; check exact font alignment
parser_qualification: One L009 cover Form summary visitor callback duplicates its child text; only that aggregate callback is ignored for font alignment. page.extract_text() remains the exact counted raw string. Actual event replay recursively visits all Form XObjects once.

formulas.characters_without_whitespace: sum(not c.isspace() for c in text)

comparison_policy.written: sum of both whole source PDFs / (whole U_G + whole G1 + whole G2), first comparison
comparison_policy.including_program: sum of both whole source PDFs / (whole U_G + whole G1 + whole G2 + whole CODE), separate comparison
comparison_policy.raw_program_alternative: same written denominator plus all thirteen complete raw programs once instead of CODE, never added to CODE
comparison_policy.conditional: whole corresponding source PDF / whole application, after acquiring whole U_G and the complete programme; programme roles remain four finite premises, two witness/certificate bridges, seven validation files

calibration: 509 source substitutions, each tied to physical page, full-text offset, original PDF event and byte, font stream, glyph name and context. Full underlying font-class audit is retained. Actual and generated whitespace unchanged.
